rationale: Retain the published CoolCo record as the one canonical Cincinnati district-cooling business and retire the seed-only CoolCo (Cincinnati District Energy) identity. Direct manager, operator, regulatory and filing evidence supports Harrison Street Social Infrastructure Fund as the current owner from 2019, I Squared's 100% ownership from 2014 to 2019, DTE's predecessor ownership through June 2014 and documented Cinergy participation beginning in 1998. Exact Harrison closing date, stake and intermediate entity chain are not publicly disclosed and are preserved as disclosure limitations rather than inferred. No later sale, recapitalization or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.

companyFieldUpdates.description: CoolCo is the district-cooling utility serving Cincinnati's central business district through central and satellite chilled-water plants and an underground distribution network. The system has operated since April 1997, serves commercial, hotel, retail, government and institutional buildings, and is reported to provide more than 10,000 tons of cooling across approximately 5.2 million square feet. Harrison Street acquired ISQ CoolCo for the Harrison Street Social Infrastructure Fund in 2019 and remains the current verified owner; its exact stake and acquisition vehicle are not publicly disclosed. I Squared Capital acquired 100% of DTE CoolCo in 2014 through ISQ Global Infrastructure Fund, following earlier DTE and Cinergy ownership. Ever-Green Energy provides operations and management services but is not the owner. No later sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.
